headline: A 431-page metadata and structure pass across Cortex XSIAM; UPN becomes a mandatory XDM authentication field
summary_md:
- 366 of the 434 changed files touch nothing but their `description:` frontmatter — a metadata pass over almost the whole Cortex XSIAM book.
- The XDM authentication mapping reference carries the day's only substantive change: `xdm.source.user.upn` is promoted from optional to mandatory, and a new `OPERATION_TYPE_AUDIT` constant is added.
- Structural cleanup elsewhere: bold pseudo-headings promoted to real `###` headings in 22 files, and "Note"/"Notice" sub-headings stripped from 14 callouts.
- Five pages moved their numbered procedures into GitBook `{% stepper %}` blocks.
- Six pages were retitled. No page was added, removed, or moved — every one of the 434 entries is a modification.

highlights.title: xdm.source.user.upn is now a mandatory XDM authentication field
highlights.detail: It moved out of the collapsed "Authentication identity and context" optional section into the mandatory list as field 12, pushing xdm.event.outcome_reason to 13.

highlights.title: New XDM_CONST.OPERATION_TYPE_AUDIT constant for authorization and policy evaluation events
highlights.detail: An accompanying note tells mappers there is no neutral member: leave the field unmapped when the kind is unclear, and unset for logouts, so logout events do not inflate login metrics.

highlights.title: 409 pages gained or rewrote a description: frontmatter line
highlights.detail: The new descriptions consistently name the product ("in Cortex XSIAM") where the old ones did not, and 366 pages changed in no other way.

highlights.title: Six pages were retitled without moving
highlights.detail: "About health issues" became "Health issues in Cortex XSIAM", "Extract Indicators" became "Extract indicators in playbooks", and four others; the nav manifest records the new titles against unchanged paths, so no link or bookmark breaks.

highlights.title: Numbered procedures converted to GitBook stepper blocks on five pages
highlights.detail: Registering an agent action and adding an integration instance both gained per-step headings in the process, but the steps themselves are unchanged.

highlights.title: Callout hints lost their redundant "Note" and "Notice" headings
highlights.detail: Fourteen occurrences across nine pages, including three legacy data-gb-custom-block divs rewritten to the {% hint %} shorthand.

items.xsiam/reference-and-developer-docs/refer: Makes xdm.source.user.upn mandatory, adds the OPERATION_TYPE_AUDIT constant, and drops a sentence duplicated in the IDP/SP mapping note.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/configure-t: The nine-step action registration procedure becomes a stepper block; the inline hint about mandatory arguments survives inside step 8.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Seven steps rewritten as a stepper with a heading each, splitting on-demand instance use and command access into their own steps.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/automations: Twelve-step prompt creation procedure wrapped in a stepper; one sentence about context-path inputs is regrammared.
Folds the "Search tips" collapsible into the preceding hint and converts the procedure to a stepper.
Unindents the input/output grouping section out of a list item, and raises the system-playbook permission note from an info hint to a warning.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Retitled "Health issues in Cortex XSIAM"; the rewrite leaves a corrupted phrase, "health-relatedhealth related errors", in the opening paragraph.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/configure-t: Prose reworked to name Cortex XSIAM and RBAC explicitly throughout; the component model and the four configuration steps are unchanged.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/cortex-xsia: Retitled from "Google Cloud Platform cloud onboarding" to "Google Cloud Platform onboarding".
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/automations: Retitled "Filter and transform Cortex XSIAM playbook data"; body changes are heading promotions only.
Retitled "Extract indicators in playbooks", correcting the capitalisation of the old title.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/engines/eng: Hardware, operating system and required-URL sections become real headings; the requirements themselves, including the CentOS 7 EOL notice, are untouched.
items.xsiam/configure-cortex-xsiam/automations: Gains a description and an Unified Asset Inventory heading; the Premium-licence and Cloud add-on entitlement text is unchanged.
items.agent-releases/cortex-xdr-agent-releases: The agent release table gains data-search="false"; no release rows changed.
